title: "Shannon entropy"
output: html_document
date: "2025-12-21"
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rstatix)
})

# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_IUPAC_exploratory.rds")

meta_single <- read_csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  )

top_sites <- c("liver", "brain", "bone")

df_site_top <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

# -----------------------------
# Shannon entropy per sample
# -----------------------------
entropy_df <- df_site_top %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    metastatic_sites = first(metastatic_sites),

    # use only positive probabilities
    entropy = -sum(freq.corrected[freq.corrected > 0] * log(freq.corrected[freq.corrected > 0])),

    # optional sanity checks
    sum_p = sum(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_motifs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Quick sanity prints
message("Samples: ", n_distinct(entropy_df$id))
message("Entropy summary:"); print(summary(entropy_df$entropy))
message("Sum(freq.corrected) summary (should be ~1):"); print(summary(entropy_df$sum_p))
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Compare entropy across sites
# -----------------------------
res_entropy_kw <- kruskal_test(entropy ~ metastatic_sites, data = entropy_df)
print(res_entropy_kw)

# Effect size for entropy difference
res_entropy_eff <- kruskal_effsize(entropy ~ metastatic_sites, data = entropy_df)
print(res_entropy_eff)

# Optional: pairwise if global test is suggestive
res_entropy_pairwise <- entropy_df %>%
  wilcox_test(entropy ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  arrange(p.adj)
print(res_entropy_pairwise)

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Save outputs
# -----------------------------
outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/IUPAC_exploratory"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

write_csv(entropy_df, file.path(outdir, "entropy_per_sample_top_sites.csv"))
write_csv(as.data.frame(res_entropy_kw), file.path(outdir, "entropy_kw_top_sites.csv"))
write_csv(as.data.frame(res_entropy_eff), file.path(outdir, "entropy_effsize_top_sites.csv"))
write_csv(as.data.frame(res_entropy_pairwise), file.path(outdir, "entropy_pairwise_wilcox_top_sites.csv"))

```
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

# -------------------------------------------------
# INPUT
# entropy_df must contain:
# id, metastatic_sites, entropy, n_motifs
# -------------------------------------------------

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/figures_entropy/results_IUPAC_exploratory"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Order sites by median RAW entropy (fixed order)
# -------------------------------------------------
site_order <- entropy_df %>%
  group_by(metastatic_sites) %>%
  summarise(med_entropy = median(entropy), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(med_entropy) %>%
  pull(metastatic_sites)

entropy_df <- entropy_df %>%
  mutate(metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = site_order))

# -------------------------------------------------
# RAW SHANNON ENTROPY PLOT
# -------------------------------------------------
p_entropy_raw <- ggplot(entropy_df, aes(x = metastatic_sites, y = entropy)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "grey85", color = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site",
    y = "Shannon entropy (4-mer end motifs)",
    title = "Global end-motif diversity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

# Save RAW entropy plots
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "entropy_raw_violin.png"),
  plot = p_entropy_raw,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "entropy_raw_violin.pdf"),
  plot = p_entropy_raw,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# NORMALIZED SHANNON ENTROPY
# -------------------------------------------------
entropy_df <- entropy_df %>%
  mutate(entropy_norm = entropy / log(n_motifs))

p_entropy_norm <- ggplot(entropy_df, aes(x = metastatic_sites, y = entropy_norm)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "grey85", color = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site",
    y = "Normalized Shannon entropy",
    title = "Normalized end-motif diversity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

# Save NORMALIZED entropy plots
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "entropy_normalized_violin.png"),
  plot = p_entropy_norm,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "entropy_normalized_violin.pdf"),
  plot = p_entropy_norm,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5
)

```
